a.text: We don't want to play with her, she's a freak without a papa!

spans.text: We don't want to play with her, she's a freak without a papa!

a.text: Hahaha, Rosalind's a rotten girl without a papa!

spans.text: Hahaha, Rosalind's a rotten girl without a papa!

steps.text: I'm not a rotten girl!
I-I won't let you call me that...!

a.text: Yow! Sh-She hit us first! See, she's a bad kid!

spans.text: Yow! Sh-She hit us first! See, she's a bad kid!

steps.text: If you wanna fight, you'll get one! I'm not scared of you!
I'm not a bad kid!
I'm fine with just my mamochka, I don't need a papa!
I don't need a...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Didn't expect I'd fall headfirst into them.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: The trees... they were here all along.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Two trees growing into each other, this has to be them.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: ...Okay, that should do it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Now that mom's business is done, I'll...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Nope, can't climb back up.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: The snow's too thick, and the hill's too steep to make it back up with my bare hands.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: There's only this cliff here left to try...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: W-Wait, Rosalind!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: *cough*, *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Get away from there, it's dangerous!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Okay, okay, I'm getting away! You stay put too!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You can't move your legs, right? Just take a rest and don't push yourself.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Just a scratch. Not like I'd ever let you fall.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Those Victorian bastards actually dragged you into their plans... I won't let them get away with it!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So that guy's really a Victorian spy?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: He, well... he didn't actually do anything to me.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It'll be too late when he does!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'd have beat him so badly he wouldn't dare to set foot on Paleroche land ever again, if only we didn't have such bad luck!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Before you came out of nowhere, I was about to tie the bastard up and teach him a lesson!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Whatever, let's just drop it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Back there, you...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ugh, I hate it when people take their sweet time beating around the bush, so I'll just ask!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So, why did you move to protect me when we fell?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And that Victorian guy, what was he talking about? Something to do with who somebody is?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Rosalind.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I know you might find what I'm about to say hard to accept, but...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Tatyana and I—

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Your mother and I met on the summit of this mountain.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You... and mamochka... you mean, you're...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Rosalind, you're my daughter.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: A most unusual guest.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What business has you hurrying over here today, Ratatos?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You must know exactly what it is, Enciodes.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Are you sure we can fool that Victorian Trilby Asher with our bait?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The smarter a man is, the more confident he is in his own judgement, correct?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That's for sure.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: But Enciodes, here's a warning for you too. Don't underestimate people.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That Victorian spy seems to be pretty misled. He's chasing Arctosz's daughter all right, but I don't think things are gonna keep going that smoothly.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What if he doesn't go according to your plans? How are you gonna handle that?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You must have some sort of backup plan?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Arctosz's daughter deciding to return to Kjerag now is indeed outside the scope of our plans.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Of course, I couldn't possibly think such an improvised plan would suffice to solve our problem.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: It sounds like you have something up your sleeve.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Let me see... why haven't I seen Gnosis today?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And the bodyguard always at your side. I heard from my sister and brother-in-law she hasn't been helping you train your Tschäggättä recently.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You get your information fast, Ratatos.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Gnosis and Degenbrecher naturally have their own jobs to do, and if you're here to see them today, I'm afraid you'll have to leave disappointed.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'm not looking for them.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Although... ah, yes. I had a piece of 'good news' for Gnosis, if he was here.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Nothing major, you'll know all about it tomorrow.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: He's said this before, but I'll personally remind you, Enciodes. You'd better be certain of the things happening below Kjeragandr's statue...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: It's not just about one Clan Silverash. You'd do well to remember that us Browntails also have a stake in it!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's etched into my mind.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Whether it be the tri-clans or the Vine-Bead Court led by the Saintess...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Ratatos, you should hold a little more confidence.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Whether it be in you, me, Gnosis, or even Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: All that we do here is for Kjerag's future.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That is my firm belief.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Run enough laps yet?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Also, I must retrieve my words from earlier, Madam Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What's come into your clever little mind now?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The Black Knight indeed does not lie.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: A brazen misunderstanding on my part.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I thought young Larina was the key to the plans unfolding in Kjerag...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Were it not for that, I wouldn't have the slightest intention of establishing contact, and yet so many clues have appeared...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Madam, you did not come to block me from approaching Arctosz or Rosalind.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You're here to deepen the misunderstanding, yes?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Done talking?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Smart people always talk so much. I don't get why. I can't be bothered.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Now, pick up your weapon.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Let me see how sharp Victoria's claws are.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: No, no, no.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I surrender.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Is there a need for us to fight? This is a complete misunderstanding.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You were right, I should head down the mountain for lunch.
The Trilby Asher calmly raises his hands and walks past Degenbrecher.
But as his back faces hers, he suddenly stops moving.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: However...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: This is only a little guess of mine, Madam Degenbrecher.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: To the best of my knowledge, Enciodes is not one to act without purpose.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: If Madam Larina is truly uninvolved, I believe he wouldn't use her as bait.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: She is certainly not suspicious. So, could it be the Paleroche clan behind her?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Could it be... there's something amiss with the Paleroche spirits, or rather, the transport route they arranged for the alcohol?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Madam Larina's appearance was an unexpected affair.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: And it is precisely because of that, you worry that once I meet her, I might just stumble upon Clan Paleroche in the course of my investigation and discover something I shouldn't have.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: This is why you've performed an entire show for me.
Degenbrecher does not answer, and merely raises her weapons, slowly.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The Paleroches are in charge of transporting various resources for Kjerag.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: And all transport railways in the country converge on the same spot, Lake Silberneherze. To elaborate, what's important is... the island in the middle of the lake underneath the Kjeragandr statue.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Perhaps there are some secrets hidden there.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Would an intelligence officer divulge his own answers?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: No.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Everyone has their own strengths. For example, you'd be stronger than most of Victoria. However—

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You cannot control the subtle expressions you're not even aware you're making.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I believe my guess is correct.
Degenbrecher wields her weapons with no mercy in mind, but the Trilby Asher is one step ahead of her.
He dodges the blast waves, the snow flying everywhere, and her murderous intent as he leaps down the mountain.
Degenbrecher gives chase.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: The burdenbeast observation car is about to depart for Lake Silberneherze.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: Our professionally trained burdenbeasts can bring you to every scenic spot and all the best views!

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: Travelers who want to enjoy spectacular vistas to on the way to the lake, don't miss this chance!

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I need to head over to Lake Silberneherze. Give me your fastest burdenbeast.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: You'll have to pay extra for that, sir.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Name your price. I'm currently being hunted by a sinister woman, so do me a favor, friend.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: If someone asks where I went, just tell them you don't know. Alright?

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: I've seen something like this before, on those discs my daughter sent me.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: (Whistle)

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: That's the one. Fastest girl I got, Takme.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: And don't worry, sir. My lips are sealed.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Many thanks.
The Trilby Asher nimbly jumps into the seat on the burdenbeast's back.
The beast begins to move, and breaks into a run towards the lake.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: Pfft. Foreigners are so funny. I'll have to tell my girl about this when she comes back.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Have you seen a foreigner dressed in a black coat?

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: It's really happening! Sorry, I didn't—

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: Eh? Madam Degenbrecher?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You know me?

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: Don't you remember, when my Takme got stuck in a quagmire while transporting goods last year? You happened to be passing by and pulled her out!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Oh, right. That happened.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: So, you didn't see anyone, right? Then—

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: That bastard actually called you sinister, and I even let him borrow Takme!

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: I'm going to teach him a lesson for sure!
He picks up a transceiver.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: Takme! Stop, that's a bad guy!

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Phew. A burdenbeast's adaptability is not to be underestimated, but the crucial trait is its robust endurance.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Perhaps it could serve as a strategic resource—

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Eh?
The burdenbeast underneath him suddenly turns restless with impatience.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Renter
steps.text: Madam Degenbrecher, Takme's over here!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Gah—Have I been caught?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Bloody—

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Grr—

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Give up already. I'll be watching whatever it is you're up to today.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Even if my only desire is to see the local sights?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I know Kjerag pretty well.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I can't be doing this.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Lively Local
steps.text: I'm definitely learning how to ice-skate today.

steps.name: Calm Local
steps.text: You've been saying that for a month already, and summer's already on its way.

steps.name: Calm Local
steps.text: You'll have to wait for a long, long time for the lake to freeze over.

steps.name: Lively Local
steps.text: And that's why I'll definitely get it down today!

steps.name: Calm Local
steps.text: Okay, okay, okay.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Sorry, I need to borrow these for a bit.

steps.name: Lively Local
steps.text: Hey, my skates!

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Here's some money for a new pair.
During his thorough investigation of Kjerag, the Trilby Asher has seen many locals skating on the ice underneath the warm winter sun.
He's thought that an activity like this could be somewhat enjoyable, and has wanted to try it, if he had the time.
An opportunity has unexpectedly presented itself to him.
But soon, he discovers he has made a gross misjudgment—

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Oh, um—

steps.name: Calm Local
steps.text: I thought you knew how to skate, man.

steps.name: Calm Local
steps.text: He's obviously new, so unstable.

steps.name: Fallen 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Stable? Oh, I see.

steps.name: Fallen 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Gah, sod it.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Move.

steps.name: Calm Local
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Lively Local
steps.text: Whoaaaaa! Someone's flying in from up high!

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Stability, balance, right, yes, I've got it!
With a loud bang, Degenbrecher's attack smashes a gigantic hole into the icy surface.
The Trilby Asher dodges the blow in the nick of time.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Wow, I got it down!

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: How delightful. I'll definitely promote this sport after I return home!

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Of course, I have to survive the day first.

steps.name: Lively Local
steps.text: H-H-He, he actually learned how to skate!

steps.name: Calm Local
steps.text: I've never seen someone get it down that quickly...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hmph. Is there a spare pair around?

steps.name: Calm Local
steps.text: Ah, why don't I, lend you mine?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Calm Local
steps.text: Do you...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I do.

steps.name: Calm Local
steps.text: So fast!
